title: StackOptimizer
description: Reduces server lag by stacking dropped items and optimizing TNT explosions while keeping gameplay vanilla-like.
body:
**StackOptimizer** is a lightweight performance plugin designed to reduce lag caused by item entities and TNT explosions — without changing the core Minecraft experience.

### ✨ Features

**🧲 Smart Item Stacking**

* Nearby dropped items automatically merge into full stacks
* Magnet effect pulls items together
* Significantly reduces entity count and lag

**💥 Optimized TNT Explosions**

* Explosions remain instant (no delay or weird behavior)
* Limits the number of processed blocks to prevent lag spikes
* Configurable system to control which blocks drop items

**⚙️ Configurable**

* Choose which blocks should NOT drop items (e.g. dirt, cobblestone)
* Control explosion size limit
* Easily tweak performance vs gameplay balance

### 🧠 Why use this?

Vanilla Minecraft struggles with:

* Large explosions (TNT spam)
* Massive item drops (mining, farms)

This plugin:

* Keeps explosions smooth and instant
* Reduces unnecessary item drops
* Improves server TPS without ruining gameplay

### 🛠️ Example config

```yaml
no-drop-materials:
  - DIRT
  - COBBLESTONE

max-blocks: 150
```

### 🚀 Perfect for:

* Survival servers
* SMPs
* TNT-heavy gameplay
* Performance-focused setups
